title: S2 missed connection — LIVE planner + LIVE Atlas RECORD proof (honest sandbox truth)

boundaries.note: traveller-state report through the real POST /api/runtime/missed-flight boundary; no external provider involved
Model Studio (qwen-class) recovery planning through the provider-neutral model client; schema-validated, fail-closed
LIVE sandbox corridor search/verify through the Atlas adapter; sanitized recordings persisted for REPLAY

steps.description: Traveller reports missed KUL->SIN connection (pack msg-ait-s2-001); explicit elementId because the report lands after the leg's scheduled departure (DR-7 seam)

body.travellerReport: Hi - stuck in KL. My flight out of Sydney left about five hours late (weather holding) and I missed my connection to Singapore. The airline desk rebooked me on a flight tomorrow morning at 8:10, landing just after 9. I present at the hackathon finals tomorrow afternoon and I am supposed to be at the lab in the morning too. My suitcase went on the morning flight apparently. What do we do?
